phone_token = phone_login['access_token']
venmo_token = venmo_login['access_token']

def fetch_all_phone_contacts(token):
    page = 0
    limit = 20
    all_contacts = []
    while True:
        result = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=token, page_index=page, page_limit=limit)
        if not result:
            break
        all_contacts.extend(result)
        if len(result) < limit:
            break
        page += 1
    return all_contacts

def fetch_all_venmo_friends(token):
    page = 0
    limit = 20
    all_friends = []
    while True:
        result = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=token, page_index=page, page_limit=limit)
        if not result:
            break
        all_friends.extend(result)
        if len(result) < limit:
            break
        page += 1
    return all_friends
